decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - That the London Borough of Spelthorne be advised that objection is raised to the proposal for the following reason. 

The proposed siting and appearance of the development is considered to represent an inappropriate and obtrusive feature in the locality, the effect of which would unduly impact on the visual amenity and open character of the area. The proposal is therefore contrary to policies ENV.1.1, ENV.1.12 and ENV 4.4 of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan and policies ENV.B.1.1, ENV.B.1.7 and ENV-N.1.2  of the Review Deposit Unitary Development Plan and Planning Policy Guidance Note 8.
description: Replacement of existing 15m high 02 masts with 26.8m high Orange Lattice Telecoms tower incorporating 6 no polar antennaes and 4 no dish antennae with associated equipment cabin
